modules.name: Governance Catalog / Bootstrap
modules.input: public package registrations and governance_core contracts
modules.output: registered governance services

modules.name: Project Manager / Discovery
modules.input: ATP project manifest and root
modules.output: discoverable project registration

modules.name: Project Router / Runtime Binding
modules.input: projectRoot and registered projects
modules.output: selected ATP projectId

modules.name: ATP Task Classification / Context Contribution
modules.input: intent, module, change, IP and lane
modules.output: project governance contribution and obligations

modules.name: Architecture Navigator
modules.trigger: context assembly for a routed task
modules.input: project architecture resources and task classification
modules.output: architecture routes and boundaries

modules.name: Rule Manager
modules.trigger: context assembly for a routed task
modules.input: rule catalog and task classification
modules.output: resolved mandatory rules

modules.name: Knowledge Manager / Consult
modules.input: project knowledge registry, task route and query
modules.output: ranked knowledge records and consultation decision

modules.name: Knowledge Validation Policy
modules.input: knowledge status, source and evidence
modules.output: admission or validation decision

modules.name: Context Builder
modules.input: project, architecture, rules, knowledge, gates and contributor output
modules.output: compiled Task Context

modules.name: Context Management / Update
modules.trigger: closure reflection reports durable context delta
modules.input: reflection context section and evidence state
modules.output: persisted context update consumable by a later turn

modules.name: Gate Manager
modules.input: gate plans, evidence and producer mapping
modules.output: gate state and blocking decision

modules.name: Evidence State Manager
modules.input: evidence records and provenance
modules.output: canonical evidence state

modules.name: Experience Memory Manager
modules.trigger: reflection and closure when reusable experience exists
modules.input: experience reflection candidates
modules.output: durable experience decision or NONE

modules.name: Auto Governance Engine
modules.trigger: task bootstrap and governance decision assembly
modules.input: resolved project governance contributions
modules.output: auto-governance context and obligation contribution

modules.name: Runtime Work Observation
modules.input: bounded work observation with task and turn binding
modules.output: Runtime-owned observation/evidence update

modules.name: Execution Supervisor
modules.trigger: supervised turn open, trusted events, preflight and completion
modules.input: Runtime-bound event store, obligations and actions
modules.output: supervision status, violations and readiness

modules.name: Obligation Ledger
modules.trigger: supervised turn creation and every trusted execution event
modules.input: validated obligation contribution and durable events
modules.output: PENDING, SATISFIED or VIOLATED obligation state

modules.name: WRITE_SCOPE Preflight
modules.trigger: explicit harness_preflight for a proposed mutation
modules.input: action, path and frozen write scope
modules.output: ALLOW or BLOCK without pretending host-wide ENFORCE

modules.name: Required Resource Enforcement
modules.trigger: harness_read_required followed by trusted receipt admission
modules.input: Runtime-selected required resource and actual file content
modules.output: trusted REQUIRED_RESOURCE event and obligation progression

modules.name: Trusted Validation Admission
modules.input: Runtime-selected command and actual exit/output
modules.output: trusted validation span and matching obligation progression

modules.name: Agent Governance Kernel / Turn Journal
modules.trigger: turn open, reflection, sealing and closure
modules.input: task/turn binding and Runtime-owned lifecycle facts
modules.output: durable turn journal with monotonic lifecycle

modules.name: Unified Reflection
modules.input: exact task/turn binding and durable work evidence
modules.output: validated TurnReflectionResult bound to readiness

modules.name: Knowledge Decision / Classification / Promotion
modules.trigger: reflection and closure when knowledge is NONE or a candidate
modules.input: reflection candidates, source refs and verification evidence
modules.output: NONE, CHECK, DOCUMENT or evidence-check decision and bounded persistence

modules.name: Mandatory Closure Adapters
modules.input: reflection and current governed state
modules.output: eight replayable module receipts

modules.name: Closure Coordinator
modules.input: sealed journal, reflection and mandatory module receipts
modules.output: CLOSED only after every mandatory module succeeds

modules.name: Runtime / Gateway Rehydrate and Replay
modules.trigger: Gateway restart and access to an existing supervised task
modules.input: durable turn, event store, ledger and kernel state
modules.output: same lifecycle and obligation state after restart

modules.name: Execution Event Store
modules.trigger: supervised turn creation and trusted event append
modules.input: binding-checked lifecycle and execution events
modules.output: append-only durable event sequence and cursor

modules.name: ATP Gate Evidence Provider
modules.input: ATP gate plan, command and real execution result
modules.output: provider-bound gate evidence without self-asserted PASS

modules.name: Context Closure Module
modules.input: context reflection section
modules.output: context update or explicit NO_CHANGE receipt

modules.name: Knowledge Closure Module
modules.input: scoped knowledge candidates and provenance
modules.output: candidate persistence or explicit NO_CHANGE receipt

modules.name: Experience Memory Closure Module
modules.input: project-scoped evidence-backed experience candidates
modules.output: experience state update or explicit NO_CHANGE receipt

modules.name: Architecture Closure Module
modules.input: architecture candidates
modules.output: non-canonical change candidate or explicit NO_CHANGE receipt

modules.name: Rules Closure Module
modules.input: rule candidates
modules.output: non-canonical change candidate or explicit NO_CHANGE receipt

modules.name: Evidence State Closure Module
modules.input: project-scoped evidence reflection
modules.output: INFO evidence only or explicit NO_CHANGE receipt

modules.name: Working Set Closure Module
modules.input: working-set keep/add/remove reflection
modules.output: context working-set update or explicit NO_CHANGE receipt

modules.name: Obligation / Gate Reconcile Closure Module
modules.input: Supervisor state, gate evidence and proposed obligation transitions
modules.output: Runtime-owned reconciliation; agent proposals cannot self-resolve

modules.name: Governance Runtime Lifecycle
modules.trigger: open, observe, preflight, status and close
modules.input: Runtime/project/task/turn-bound governance facts
modules.output: monotonic lifecycle with fail-closed identity checks
